mobile_access_full_detail: Can see this computer, restart services, run actions, watch and type in terminals and answer agent permission prompts.
mobile_access_none_detail: Paired, but it can do nothing until you allow something.
mobile_access_view_detail: Can look at projects, logs and agents. Cannot change anything or watch terminals.
mobile_access_view_terminals_detail: Can look at projects, logs, agents and terminals. Cannot change anything.
mobile_activity_crewmate_task: Sent a task to a crewmate
mobile_activity_prompt: Sent a prompt to an agent

match.countPlural=one: Sent a prompt to an agent ({count} character)
match.countPlural=*: Sent a prompt to an agent ({count} characters)

mobile_activity_terminal_signal: Sent a signal to a terminal
mobile_pair_card_code_lifetime: A code works for two minutes.
mobile_pair_card_error_body: {error}. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart Atlas.
mobile_pair_card_link_copied: Pairing link copied. In the app, choose Paste link.
mobile_pair_card_paired_body: It is in the list below.
mobile_pair_card_step_get_testing: Still in testing, not in the stores yet.
mobile_pair_card_step_open_hint: Tap {#em}Scan pairing code{/em}, or {#em}Pair another computer{/em} in its Settings.
mobile_pair_card_step_scan_hint: The phone appears in {#em}Paired phones{/em} below the moment it connects.

match.countExact=0, countPlural=*: This code has no direct addresses, so the phone uses the relay.

mobile_pair_help_awake: {#b}Keep this computer awake{/b} with Atlas running. A sleeping computer cannot be reached; the phone connects again once it wakes.
mobile_pair_help_vpn: {#b}VPN or Cloudflare WARP on?{/b} Pause it, or exclude your Wi-Fi network from it, then make a new code.
mobile_pair_help_vpn_docs: Pairing fails with a VPN or WARP on
mobile_pair_help_wifi: {#b}The phone does not need to be on this Wi-Fi.{/b} It connects through an encrypted relay, or straight to this computer when both are on the same network.
mobile_pair_qr_expired: The code expired. Make a new one.
mobile_phone_activity_empty: Nothing yet. What the phone changes here (a restart, a prompt, an approval) is listed; just looking around is not.

match.countPlural=one: The last action. Text typed on the phone is recorded by its length only.
match.countPlural=*: The last {count} actions. Text typed on the phone is recorded by its length only.

mobile_phone_row_name_description: Only you see it, here. It helps tell your phones apart.
mobile_phone_row_unpair_body: It is disconnected at once and can no longer reach this computer, and its push notifications stop. To use it again, scan a new code.
mobile_scope_act_label: Restart services, run actions, send prompts
mobile_scope_act_risk: Changes your running stack, creates and removes worktrees, commits and pushes, updates Atlas, tells agents what to do.
mobile_scope_approve_risk: Can allow an agent to run a tool or a command.
mobile_scope_read_risk: Reads names, status, logs, diffs and agent conversations. Changes nothing.
mobile_scope_term_read_risk: Sees everything a terminal prints, secrets included.
mobile_scope_term_write_risk: Runs commands as you, like sitting at the keyboard.
